name: ClickUp
description: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, allowing teams to plan, organize, and collaborate across projects with customizable workflows

tools.name: Add dependency
tools.description: Adds a 'waiting on' or 'blocking' dependency to a task, requiring either `depends_on` (task becomes waiting on) or `dependency_of` (task becomes blocking), but not both; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the task to which a dependency relationship will be added.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Team ID, required if `custom_task_ids` is true to look up tasks by custom IDs (unique per team).

inputs.name: depends_on
inputs.about: ID of the task that `task_id` will depend on ('waiting on' relationship). Use this or `dependency_of`, not both.

inputs.name: dependency_of
inputs.about: ID of the task that will depend on `task_id` ('blocking' relationship). Use this or `depends_on`, not both.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If true, `task_id` and related task IDs are custom (text-based), requiring `team_id`.

tools.name: Add guest to folder
tools.description: Adds a guest to a folder with specified permissions; requires a ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the guest user to be added to the folder.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the folder to which the guest will be added.

inputs.name: include_shared
inputs.about: If `true`, include shared item details (API default if parameter is omitted); if `false`, exclude them.

inputs.name: permission_level
inputs.about: Permission level for the guest. Options are 'read' (view only), 'comment', 'edit', or 'create' (full access).

tools.name: Add guest to list
tools.description: Shares a ClickUp List with an existing guest user, granting them specified permissions; requires the Workspace to be on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the List to which the guest will be added.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the guest user to be added to the List.

inputs.name: include_shared
inputs.about: A boolean indicating whether to include details of items shared with the guest in the response. Set to `false` to exclude these details. If not provided or set to `true` (the API default), shared item details are included.

inputs.name: permission_level
inputs.about: The permission level to be granted to the guest on this List. Accepted values are: `read` (view-only), `comment` (can add comments), `edit` (can edit existing items), or `create` (full access, including creating new items).

tools.name: Add guest to task
tools.description: Assigns a guest to a task with specified permissions; requires ClickUp Enterprise Plan, and `team_id` if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task to which the guest will be added.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Required if `custom_task_ids` is `true` to correctly identify the task when using a custom task ID.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the guest user to be added to the task.

inputs.name: include_shared
inputs.about: Optional. If set to `false`, details of items already shared with the guest will be excluded. The API defaults to `true` if this parameter is not explicitly set to `false`.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Optional. Set to `true` if you are referencing the task by its custom task ID. If `true`, `team_id` must also be provided.

inputs.name: permission_level
inputs.about: Permission level for the guest on this task. Must be one of: `read` (view only), `comment` (view and comment), `edit` (view, comment, and edit), or `create` (full permissions).

tools.name: Add tags from time entries
tools.description: Associates a list of specified tags with one or more time entries within a given Team (Workspace).

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: A list of tag objects to add to the time entries. Each object should define the tag, typically including a 'name', and optionally 'tag_fg' (foreground color hex code) and 'tag_bg' (background color hex code).

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Team (Workspace) where the time entries are located.

inputs.name: time_entry_ids
inputs.about: A list of unique string identifiers for the time entries to which the tags will be added.

tools.name: Add tag to task
tools.description: Adds an existing tag to a specified task; team_id is required if custom_task_ids is true.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task to which the tag will be added. This can be the standard task ID or a custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is set to `true`.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team (formerly Workspace) to which the task belongs. This is required only if `custom_task_ids` is set to `true`. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: The name of the tag to add to the task. The tag must already exist in the workspace.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: A boolean flag indicating whether the `task_id` provided is a custom task ID. If `true`, the `team_id` must also be provided.

tools.name: Add task link
tools.description: Links two existing and accessible ClickUp tasks, identified by `task_id` (source) and `links_to` (target).

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the source task.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team, used when `custom_task_ids` is true to identify tasks by custom IDs. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: links_to
inputs.about: The ID of the target task.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Set to `true` to indicate that `task_id` and `links_to` are custom task IDs rather than standard numerical IDs. If `true`, `team_id` must also be provided.

tools.name: Add task to list
tools.description: Adds an existing task to an additional ClickUp List; the "Tasks in Multiple Lists" ClickApp must be enabled in the Workspace for this.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the List to which the task will be added.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the task to add to the List (actual task ID, not Custom Task ID).

tools.name: Create task attachment
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use `create_task_attachment` to upload a file to a task; requires `multipart/form-data`.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task to which the attachment will be added.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team. This is required and used only if `custom_task_ids` is `true` to help locate the task by its custom ID. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: attachment
inputs.about: The file to be uploaded as an attachment. Note: Files stored in the cloud (URLs) cannot be used - actual file content must be provided.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If `true`, indicates that `task_id` should be interpreted as a custom task ID instead of the default ClickUp task ID. If this is `true`, `team_id` must also be provided.

tools.name: Get authorized teams workspaces
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use `get_authorized_teams_workspaces` instead to retrieve Workspaces (Teams) accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Update Doc Page
tools.description: Tool to update/edit a ClickUp Doc page's title and/or content via the v3 Docs API. Use when you need to modify a Doc page's name or content programmatically.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new title/name for the page. If not provided, the page name will not be changed.

inputs.name: doc_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the document containing the page.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The new content for the page in markdown format. If not provided, the page content will not be changed. Use this field to update, replace, or append to the page content.

inputs.name: page_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the page to update.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The workspace ID containing the document.

tools.name: Create a time entry
tools.description: Creates a new time entry for a specified team.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: Alias for `stop`. The end time of the time entry, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. If both `start` and `end` are provided, the API will use these to determine the entry's actual duration, potentially overriding the `duration` field sent in the request.

inputs.name: tid
inputs.about: The ID of the task to associate this time entry with. If `custom_task_ids` is `true`, this should be the custom task ID.

inputs.name: stop
inputs.about: The stop time of the time entry, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. If both `start` and `stop` are provided, the API will use these to determine the entry's actual duration, potentially overriding the `duration` field sent in the request.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: An array of Tag objects to apply to the time entry. Each Tag object should define 'name' (string), 'tag_fg' (hex color string for foreground), and 'tag_bg' (hex color string for background). This feature is available for users on the ClickUp Business Plan and above.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: The start time of the time entry, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: team_Id
inputs.about: The Workspace ID (also called Team ID in ClickUp API) where the time entry will be added. This goes in the URL path.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Team, required only if `custom_task_ids` is set to `true`. This specifies the team context for the custom task ID. Example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: The user ID of the person to assign this time entry to. Workspace owners and admins can assign to any user ID. Workspace members can only assign to their own user ID.

inputs.name: billable
inputs.about: Indicates whether the time entry is billable. Set to `true` if billable, `false` or omit if not.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.about: The duration of the time entry in milliseconds. Note: If `start` and `end` (or `stop`) times are also provided in the request, the ClickUp API will calculate the duration based on `start` and `end`/`stop`, and this `duration` field's value might be ignored or overridden by the server.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: An optional description for the time entry.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If `true`, the `tid` parameter will be interpreted as a custom task ID. If this is `true`, the `team_id` query parameter must also be provided to specify the team context for the custom task ID.

tools.name: Create chat channel
tools.description: Tool to create a chat channel in a ClickUp workspace. Use when you need to set up a new communication channel for team collaboration with configurable visibility.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the chat channel being created.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.about: The topic of the chat channel being created.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: Optionally specify unique user IDs to add to the channel, up to 100.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Visibility level for the chat channel.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: The description for the chat channel being created.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Workspace where the chat channel will be created.

tools.name: Create chat message
tools.description: Tool to send a message in a ClickUp chat channel. Use when you need to post messages to team chat channels. Supports both regular messages and structured posts with optional assignments, followers, and reactions.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of message: 'message' for regular text messages, 'post' for structured posts.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The full content of the message to be created. Supports markdown formatting.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: The user ID of the person to assign this message to.

inputs.name: followers
inputs.about: List of user IDs to follow this message (max 10).

inputs.name: post_data
inputs.about: Data for post-type messages.

inputs.name: reactions
inputs.about: Reactions to add to the message at creation time (max 10).

inputs.name: channel_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Channel where the message will be sent.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Workspace.

inputs.name: content_format
inputs.about: Format of the message content.

inputs.name: group_assignee
inputs.about: The group ID to assign this message to.

inputs.name: triaged_action
inputs.about: The triaged action applied to the message: 1 or 2.

inputs.name: triaged_object_id
inputs.about: The message triaged action object ID.

inputs.name: triaged_object_type
inputs.about: The message triaged action object type.

tools.name: Create chat reaction
tools.description: Tool to add a reaction to a ClickUp chat message. Use when you need to react to a message with an emoji.

inputs.name: reaction
inputs.about: The emoji reaction to add, in shortcode format (e.g., '+1', '-1', 'thumbsup', 'heart', 'smile'). Use GitHub-style shortcodes without colons.

inputs.name: message_id
inputs.about: The ID of the chat message to react to.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Workspace containing the chat message.

tools.name: Create chat view comment
tools.description: Posts a new comment to a specified ClickUp Chat view; the 'view_id' must correspond to an existing and accessible Chat view.

inputs.name: view_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Chat view where the comment will be posted.

inputs.name: notify_all
inputs.about: If `True`, notifications for this comment will be sent to all members of the Chat view, including the comment creator. If `False`, notifications will follow standard ClickUp behavior.

inputs.name: comment_text
inputs.about: The text content of the comment to be added.

tools.name: Create checklist
tools.description: Creates a new checklist with a specified name within an existing task, which can be identified by its standard ID or a custom task ID (if `custom_task_ids` is true, `team_id` is also required).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new checklist.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the task for the new checklist; can be a standard or custom task ID (if `custom_task_ids` is true).

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Team's unique identifier; required only if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If true, `task_id` is treated as a custom task ID, requiring `team_id`.

tools.name: Create checklist item
tools.description: Creates a named checklist item within a specified existing checklist, optionally assigning it to a user.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new checklist item.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: User ID of the ClickUp user to whom this item will be assigned. If omitted, the item will be unassigned.

inputs.name: checklist_id
inputs.about: UUID of the parent checklist where the new item will be created; this checklist must already exist.

tools.name: Create direct message channel
tools.description: Tool to create a direct message channel in ClickUp. Use when you need to start a direct message conversation with up to 15 users. A Self DM is created when no user IDs are provided.

inputs.name: user_ids
inputs.about: The unique user IDs of participants in the direct message chat, up to 15. A Self DM is created when no user IDs are provided.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Workspace where the direct message channel will be created.

tools.name: Create Doc
tools.description: Tool to create a new ClickUp Doc in a Workspace (v3 Docs API) and return the new doc_id for follow-up page/content operations. Use when you need to create a new document in ClickUp.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name/title for the new document.

inputs.name: parent_id
inputs.about: Optional parent location ID (space, folder, or list ID) where the doc should be created. If omitted, the doc will be created at the workspace level.

inputs.name: parent_type
inputs.about: Type of parent location. Required if parent_id is provided. Must be 'space', 'folder', or 'list'.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The workspace ID where the document will be created.

tools.name: Create Doc Page
tools.description: Tool to create a page in a ClickUp Doc (v3 Docs API). Use when you need to add a new page to an existing document, either as a root page or as a sub-page under a parent page.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the new page. If not provided, page will be created with an empty name.

inputs.name: doc_id
inputs.about: The ID of the doc in format '{alphanumeric_prefix}-{number}' (e.g., '2kz0k9bp-1096'). To get a valid doc_id, use CLICKUP_CLICK_UP_SEARCH_DOCS or extract from a ClickUp Doc URL.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The content of the new page. Supports markdown or plain text based on content_format.

inputs.name: sub_title
inputs.about: The subtitle of the new page.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Workspace. Obtain this from the CLICKUP_AUTHORIZATION_GET_WORK_SPACE_LIST or CLICKUP_CLICK_UP_SEARCH_DOCS action.

inputs.name: content_format
inputs.about: The format the page content is in. Defaults to 'text/md' for markdown.

inputs.name: parent_page_id
inputs.about: The ID of the parent page. If provided, the new page will be created as a sub-page. If omitted, this will be a root page in the Doc.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Creates a new ClickUp Folder within the specified Space, which must exist and be accessible.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the Folder to be created.

inputs.name: space_id
inputs.about: Numerical ID of the Space in which to create the Folder.

tools.name: Create folderless list
tools.description: Creates a new folderless list (a list not part of any Folder) directly within a specified ClickUp Space.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new folderless list.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: List color (e.g., 'red', 'blue_blended'), distinct from task statuses within the list. Null for no color.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Description for the list (plain text or markdown).

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: `user_id` of the list owner. Null for no specific owner.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: Due date for the list (POSIX timestamp in milliseconds).

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Priority level: `1` (Urgent), `2` (High), `3` (Normal), `4` (Low). Null to remove priority.

inputs.name: space_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the Space for the new folderless list.

inputs.name: due_date_time
inputs.about: Indicates if `due_date` includes time (`true`) or is all-day (`false`). Required if `due_date` is set.

tools.name: Create folder view
tools.description: Creates a new, highly customizable view within a specific ClickUp folder using its `folder_id`.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new view.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of view to create. Options include: `list`, `board`, `calendar`, `table`, `timeline`, `workload`, `activity`, `map`, `conversation`, or `gantt`.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the folder where the new view will be created.

inputs.name: divide__dir
inputs.about: This field must be `null` (None). It is intended for specifying sort direction within divided sections, but its configuration is not fully detailed.

inputs.name: filters__op
inputs.about: Operator for combining filters. The available operator (`op`) values are `AND` and `OR`. Required when any filter parameter is provided.

inputs.name: divide__field
inputs.about: This field must be `null` (None). It is intended for view division features (e.g., swimlanes) whose specific configuration via this parameter is not fully detailed.

inputs.name: grouping__dir
inputs.about: Set a group sort order. Use `1` for ascending (e.g., urgent priority at top of the view, and tasks with no priority at the bottom) or `-1` to reverse the order (e.g., tasks with no priority at the top). Required when any grouping parameter is provided.

inputs.name: columns__fields
inputs.about: Array of field objects to display as columns in the view. Each element must be an object. Custom Fields require the `_cf` prefix followed by the Custom Field ID (e.g., `_cf_xxxxxxxx`).

inputs.name: filters__fields
inputs.about: Fields to filter by. Each element represents a filter condition. View the list of available fields in ClickUp's API documentation. Required when any filter parameter is provided.

inputs.name: filters__search
inputs.about: Text string to search for within tasks, comments, and subtasks in the view. Required when any filter parameter is provided.

inputs.name: grouping__field
inputs.about: Field to group tasks by. Options include: `none`, `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `tag`, or `dueDate`. When any grouping parameter is provided, `grouping__field`, `grouping__dir`, `grouping__collapsed`, and `grouping__ignore` are all required.

inputs.name: sorting__fields
inputs.about: Fields to sort tasks by. Each element must be an object with 'field' and 'dir' properties. 'dir' should be 1 for ascending or -1 for descending. Refer to ClickUp API for the exact structure.

inputs.name: grouping__ignore
inputs.about: If `true`, tasks with no value for the `grouping__field` will not be grouped and will appear in a separate 'Ungrouped' section. Required when any grouping parameter is provided.

inputs.name: divide__collapsed
inputs.about: Array of identifiers for divided sections to collapse by default, or null if no sections should be collapsed.

inputs.name: grouping__collapsed
inputs.about: An array of group identifiers (e.g., status names like 'Open', assignee IDs as strings like '123') that should be initially collapsed in the view. These identifiers depend on the `grouping__field` used. Required when any grouping parameter is provided.

inputs.name: filters__show__closed
inputs.about: If `true`, tasks with a closed status are included in the view.

inputs.name: settings__me__comments
inputs.about: In 'Me Mode', if `true`, show only comments where the current user is mentioned or assigned.

inputs.name: settings__me__subtasks
inputs.about: In 'Me Mode', if `true`, show only subtasks assigned to the current user.

inputs.name: settings__show__images
inputs.about: If `true`, display task cover images or image attachments.

inputs.name: settings__me__checklists
inputs.about: In 'Me Mode', if `true`, show only checklists assigned to the current user.

inputs.name: settings__show__subtasks
inputs.about: Controls subtask visibility. Acceptable integer values are `1` (show subtasks as separate tasks), `2` (expand subtasks under parent tasks), or `3` (collapse subtasks under parent tasks).

inputs.name: team__sidebar__assignees
inputs.about: List of user IDs (as strings). Tasks assigned to these users will appear in the 'Assignees' section of the team sidebar.

inputs.name: settings__show__assignees
inputs.about: If `true`, display task assignees.

inputs.name: settings__show__task__locations
inputs.about: If `true`, display the List, Folder, and Space location for tasks. When any settings parameter is provided, a complete settings object with all settings keys is required.

inputs.name: settings__show__closed__subtasks
inputs.about: If `true`, include closed subtasks in the view.

inputs.name: team__sidebar__unassigned__tasks
inputs.about: If `true`, unassigned tasks will be shown in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: team__sidebar__assigned__comments
inputs.about: If `true`, comments assigned to users will be shown in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: settings__collapse__empty__columns
inputs.about: Specifies whether to collapse columns with no tasks (e.g., in Board view). Common string values are 'true' or 'false'.

inputs.name: settings__show__subtask__parent__names
inputs.about: If `true`, display parent task names for subtasks.

tools.name: Create goal
tools.description: Creates a new goal in a ClickUp Team (Workspace).

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the goal.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: Hex color string to associate with the goal.

inputs.name: owners
inputs.about: List of user IDs to be assigned as owners of the goal.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the ClickUp Team (Workspace) where the goal will be created.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: Due date for the goal, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Detailed description for the goal.

inputs.name: multiple_owners
inputs.about: Set to `true` if the goal will have multiple owners; `false` for a single owner.

tools.name: Create key result
tools.description: Creates a new Key Result (Target) for a specified Goal in ClickUp to define and track measurable objectives towards achieving that Goal.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new Key Result.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Specifies the type of the Key Result, which determines how progress is tracked. Supported types: 'number', 'currency', 'boolean', 'percentage', 'automatic'.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.about: The unit of measurement for Key Results of type 'number', 'currency', or 'percentage' (e.g., '$', '%', 'items'). This may not be applicable for 'boolean' or 'automatic' types where progress is count-based.

inputs.name: owners
inputs.about: A list of numerical user IDs to be assigned as owners of this Key Result.

inputs.name: goal_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (UUID) of the parent Goal for which this Key Result is being created.

inputs.name: list_ids
inputs.about: An array of List UUIDs to link to this Key Result. Can be used with 'automatic' type Key Results to track progress based on tasks within these lists.

inputs.name: task_ids
inputs.about: An array of task UUIDs to link to this Key Result. Often used when `type` is 'automatic' to track progress via the completion status of these linked tasks.

inputs.name: steps_end
inputs.about: The target value indicating Key Result completion. For 'boolean' type, use 1 for true/complete. For 'automatic' type, this is often the total count of items to complete (e.g., number of linked tasks).

inputs.name: steps_start
inputs.about: The initial value for tracking Key Result progress. For 'boolean' type, use 0 for false/incomplete, 1 for true/complete. For 'automatic' type, this is often the initial count (e.g., 0).

tools.name: Create list
tools.description: Creates a new list in ClickUp within an existing folder. This action requires a folder_id - lists cannot be created directly in a Space using this action. If you need to create a list directly in a Space (without placing it in a folder), use the 'CLICKUP_CREATE_FOLDERLESS_LIST' action with space_id instead.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name to be assigned to the new list.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Optional. Defines the list's color in the ClickUp UI (e.g., 'red', 'blue'). **Important:** This 'status' refers to the visual color of the list itself, not the workflow statuses (like 'To Do', 'In Progress') of tasks within the list.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Optional descriptive content or notes for the list.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: Optional. Numerical user ID of the assignee.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: Optional due date for the list, represented as a POSIX timestamp in milliseconds. For example, `1695110307000` for September 19, 2023, 07:58:27 AM GMT.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Optional priority level for the list. Integer values map to: 1 (Urgent), 2 (High), 3 (Normal), 4 (Low).

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: The unique numerical identifier of the folder where the new list will be created. Note: This action creates a list within an existing folder. A folder_id is required and space_id cannot be used. If you want to create a list directly in a Space (without a folder), use the 'CLICKUP_CREATE_FOLDERLESS_L

inputs.name: due_date_time
inputs.about: Optional. A boolean flag indicating whether the `due_date` includes a specific time. If `True`, the time component of `due_date` is respected. If `False` or not provided, the list is considered due on the entire day specified by `due_date`.

tools.name: Create list comment
tools.description: Adds a text comment to a ClickUp List, optionally assigning it to a user and setting the notify-all preference.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the ClickUp list where the comment will be posted.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: User ID to assign this comment to, converting it into an actionable item. If omitted, creates an unassigned comment.

inputs.name: notify_all
inputs.about: If true, notifications are sent to everyone including the creator. If false or omitted, default notification rules apply.

inputs.name: comment_text
inputs.about: Text content of the comment. Supports ClickUp formatting (mentions, markdown).

tools.name: Create list from template in folder
tools.description: Creates a new list from a template in a specified ClickUp folder. Use this when you need to instantiate a list based on an existing template within a folder structure.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Name for the new list created from the template.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: The ID of the folder where the list will be created.

inputs.name: template_id
inputs.about: The ID of the template to use for creating the list.

tools.name: Create list view
tools.description: Creates a new, customizable view (e.g., list, board, calendar) within a specified ClickUp List, requiring an existing list_id accessible by the user.

inputs.name: name

inputs.name: divide__field

inputs.name: grouping__field

inputs.name: divide__collapsed

inputs.name: settings__me__checklists

tools.name: Create space view
tools.description: Creates a customizable view (e.g., List, Board, Gantt) within a specified ClickUp Space, allowing configuration of grouping, sorting, filtering, and display settings.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name for the new view.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of view to create. Valid options include: `list`, `board`, `calendar`, `table`, `timeline`, `workload`, `activity`, `map`, `conversation`, or `gantt`.

inputs.name: space_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Space where the new view will be created.

inputs.name: divide__dir
inputs.about: Sort order for divided sections. Must be `None` if included, as sort direction for divisions may not be applicable here.

inputs.name: filters__op
inputs.about: Logical operator (`AND` or `OR`) for combining filters. When ANY filter parameter is provided, ALL filter fields (op, fields, search, show_closed) are required. Defaults to 'AND' if not specified when other filter fields are present.

inputs.name: divide__field
inputs.about: Field to divide tasks by. Must be `None` if included, as division by field may not be applicable for Space views via this action.

inputs.name: grouping__dir
inputs.about: Group sort order: `1` for ascending, `-1` for descending. Required when any grouping parameter is provided.

inputs.name: columns__fields
inputs.about: Field identifiers for columns. Use standard field names (e.g., 'status') or Custom Field IDs with `_cf` prefix (e.g., 'ID_cf').

inputs.name: filters__fields
inputs.about: Fields to apply filters on. When ANY filter parameter is provided, ALL filter fields (op, fields, search, show_closed) are required. Defaults to empty array if not specified when other filter fields are present. Refer to ClickUp API documentation for available filterable fields and their syntax.

inputs.name: filters__search
inputs.about: A search string to filter tasks by keywords or specific criteria within the view. When ANY filter parameter is provided, ALL filter fields (op, fields, search, show_closed) are required. Defaults to empty string if not specified when other filter fields are present.

inputs.name: grouping__field
inputs.about: The field to group tasks by. Options include: `none`, `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `tag`, or `dueDate`. When any grouping parameter is provided, `grouping__field`, `grouping__dir`, `grouping__collapsed`, and `grouping__ignore` are all required.

inputs.name: sorting__fields
inputs.about: Fields to sort tasks by (e.g., `dueDate`, `priority`). Refer to ClickUp API documentation for a complete list of sortable fields.

inputs.name: grouping__ignore
inputs.about: If `True`, tasks not matching grouping criteria are hidden; otherwise, they are shown in a default group. Required when any grouping parameter is provided.

inputs.name: divide__collapsed
inputs.about: Array of identifiers for divided sections to collapse by default, or null if no sections should be collapsed.

inputs.name: grouping__collapsed
inputs.about: A list of string identifiers for groups that should be collapsed by default (e.g., status names like 'Closed', or assignee user IDs if grouping by assignee). Required when any grouping parameter is provided.

inputs.name: filters__show__closed
inputs.about: If `True`, closed tasks are included in the view. When ANY filter parameter is provided, ALL filter fields (op, fields, search, show_closed) are required. Defaults to false if not specified when other filter fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__me__comments
inputs.about: If `True`, in 'Me Mode', this setting filters for or highlights tasks where the current user has made comments. When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to false if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__me__subtasks
inputs.about: If `True`, in 'Me Mode', this setting filters for or highlights subtasks assigned to the current user. When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to false if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__show__images
inputs.about: If `True`, displays cover images or image attachments directly on task cards in the view. When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to true if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__me__checklists
inputs.about: If `True`, in 'Me Mode', this setting filters for or highlights tasks with checklist items assigned to the current user. When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to false if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__show__subtasks
inputs.about: How subtasks are displayed: `1` (show as separate tasks), `2` (show expanded under parent task), or `3` (show collapsed under parent task). When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to 1 if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: team__sidebar__assignees
inputs.about: A list of user IDs (as strings) to filter by in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: settings__show__assignees
inputs.about: If `True`, displays task assignees in the view (e.g., on task cards). When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to true if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__show__task__locations
inputs.about: If `True`, displays the task's location (List, Folder, Space). When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to false if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__show__closed__subtasks
inputs.about: If `True`, includes closed subtasks in the view according to other filter criteria. When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to false if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: team__sidebar__unassigned__tasks
inputs.about: If `True`, shows unassigned tasks in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: team__sidebar__assigned__comments
inputs.about: If `True`, shows tasks with comments assigned to the current user in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: settings__collapse__empty__columns
inputs.about: If 'true', collapses empty columns (e.g., status columns with no tasks). Use string 'true' or 'false'. When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to 'false' if not specified when other settings fields are present.

inputs.name: settings__show__subtask__parent__names
inputs.about: If `True`, displays the parent task name next to subtasks for clarity. When ANY settings parameter is provided, ALL settings fields are required. Defaults to false if not specified when other settings fields are present.

tools.name: Create a task
tools.description: Creates a new ClickUp task in a specific list, optionally as a subtask if a `parent` task ID (which cannot be a subtask itself and must be in the same list) is provided.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the new task.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: Tag names to apply.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: ID of an existing task to be the parent (creating a subtask). Parent must not be a subtask and must be in the same list.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Status name for the task. IMPORTANT: Each ClickUp list has its own unique status configuration. Common names like 'todo', 'done', or 'in progress' often do NOT exist - you must use the exact status names (case-sensitive) configured in the target list. To get valid statuses, call GET /list/{list_id}

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: The ID of the list where the task will be created.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Team ID, required only if `custom_task_ids` is `true`.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: Due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: links_to
inputs.about: ID of an existing task to link as a dependency.

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Priority level: 1 (Urgent), 2 (High), 3 (Normal), 4 (Low).

inputs.name: assignees
inputs.about: User IDs to assign to the task.

inputs.name: notify_all
inputs.about: `True` to send notifications to all task watchers, including the creator.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.about: Start date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Task's detailed description.

inputs.name: custom_fields
inputs.about: Custom fields to apply. See ClickUp API for structure.

inputs.name: due_date_time
inputs.about: `True` if `due_date` includes a specific time, `false` if it's an all-day task.

inputs.name: time_estimate
inputs.about: Estimated time to complete, in milliseconds.

inputs.name: custom_item_id
inputs.about: Custom task type ID. Omit or use `null` for standard tasks (recommended). Custom task types including Milestones (ID `1`) are subject to workspace plan quotas. inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Enables referencing tasks by custom task ID; requires `team_id` if `true`.

inputs.name: start_date_time
inputs.about: `True` if `start_date` includes a specific time, `false` if it's an all-day task.

inputs.name: check_required_custom_fields

inputs.about: The text content for the comment. Supports ClickUp's comment formatting (e.g., mentions, markdown).

inputs.name: comment_type
inputs.about: The type of comment to retrieve subtypes for. Use 'post' to get subtype IDs for Announcement, Discussion, Idea, and Update post types.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: ID of the logged-in user's Workspace. Obtain this from the get_authorized_teams_workspaces action or similar workspace listing endpoints.

tools.name: Get task
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a ClickUp task by its ID, supporting standard or custom task IDs (requires `team_id` for custom IDs).

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task to retrieve. This can be the standard ClickUp task ID or a custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is set to `true` (in which case `team_id` is also required).

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team. This parameter is required and used only when `custom_task_ids` is set to `true` to identify the custom task ID within that specific team. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Set to `true` to indicate that the `task_id` provided is a custom task ID. If `true`, `team_id` must also be provided. If omitted or `false` (default), `task_id` is treated as a standard task ID.

inputs.name: include_subtasks
inputs.about: Set to `true` to include subtasks in the task details response. If omitted or `false` (default), subtasks are not included.

inputs.name: include_markdown_description
inputs.about: Set to `true` to return the task description in Markdown format. If omitted or `false` (default), the description is returned in plain text. For example: `?include_markdown_description=true`.

tools.name: Get task comments
tools.description: Retrieves up to 25 comments for a specified task, supporting pagination using `start` and `start_id` to fetch older comments.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) of the oldest visible comment, used with `start_id` for paginating older comments.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the task. Can be a standard or custom task ID (if `custom_task_ids` is true).

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Team ID, required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: start_id
inputs.about: ID of the oldest visible comment, used with `start` for paginating older comments.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Indicates if `task_id` is a custom task ID; if true, `team_id` is required.

tools.name: Get task members
tools.description: Retrieves users with explicit access (directly assigned or shared) to a specific existing task, excluding users with inherited permissions.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task for which to retrieve members.

tools.name: Get tasks
tools.description: Retrieves tasks from a specified ClickUp list; only tasks whose home is the given list_id are returned, and closed and archived tasks are excluded by default. Key task attributes may appear in custom_fields, and folder may be absent; high-volume calls may return HTTP 429.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: The page number of results to fetch, starting at 0. Each page can contain up to 100 tasks. Iterate pages until the response `last_page` flag is true or the returned tasks list is empty to avoid silently missing tasks.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: Filter tasks by a list of tag names. Use URL encoding for tags with spaces (e.g., 'this%20tag').

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: The ID of the list to retrieve tasks from. To find the list_id, copy the link to the list from the ClickUp UI; the list_id is the number following '/li' in the URL. Pass as a numeric string (e.g., '123456789').

inputs.name: reverse
inputs.about: Display tasks in reverse order based on the 'order_by' field.

inputs.name: archived
inputs.about: Include or exclude archived tasks.

inputs.name: order_by
inputs.about: Field to order tasks by. Valid options are: 'id', 'created', 'updated', and 'due_date'.

inputs.name: statuses
inputs.about: Filter tasks by their status. Pass a list of status strings. Use URL encoding for statuses with spaces (e.g., 'to%20do'). To include closed tasks, use the `include_closed` parameter. Values must match workspace configuration exactly (case-sensitive, including spacing); mismatches return empty result

inputs.name: subtasks
inputs.about: Include subtasks in the results.

inputs.name: assignees
inputs.about: Filter tasks by assignee user IDs. Accepts a single ID or a list of IDs. IDs can be numeric (e.g., 212519251) or strings (e.g., '212519251').

inputs.name: due_date_gt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with a due date greater than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: due_date_lt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with a due date less than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: custom_items
inputs.about: Filter by custom task types. For example: `?custom_items[]=0&custom_items[]=1300`. Including `0` returns tasks. Including `1` returns Milestones. Including any other number returns the custom task type as defined in your Workspace.

inputs.name: date_done_gt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with a completion date greater than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: date_done_lt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with a completion date less than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: custom_fields
inputs.about: Filter tasks by custom field values. Provide a list of JSON strings, each defining a custom field filter. Example for a single filter: '[{"field_id":"field_id_1","operator":"=","value":"field_value_1"}]'. For multiple filters: '[{"field_id":"field_id_1","operator":"=","value":"field_value_1"}, {"fie

inputs.name: include_closed
inputs.about: Include tasks with a closed status. Closed tasks are excluded by default; set to true to include them.

inputs.name: date_created_gt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with a creation date greater than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: date_created_lt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with a creation date less than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: date_updated_gt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with an update date greater than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: date_updated_lt
inputs.about: Filter tasks with an update date less than the provided Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: include_markdown_description
inputs.about: Return task descriptions in Markdown format. Use the response `text_content` field instead when plain text is needed.

tools.name: Get task templates
tools.description: Retrieves task templates for a specified Workspace (Team ID), supporting pagination.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: Page number for paginating through templates (starts from 0).

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Workspace (Team) to retrieve task templates from.

tools.name: Get task s time in status
tools.description: Retrieves the duration a task has spent in each status, provided the 'Total time in Status' ClickApp is enabled for the Workspace.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the task. This can be the standard task ID or a custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team (Workspace) to which the task belongs. This is required only when `custom_task_ids` is set to `true`. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=1234567`.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If set to `true`, the `task_id` parameter will be interpreted as a custom task ID. When using custom task IDs, the `team_id` must also be provided.

tools.name: Get team available fields
tools.description: Retrieves all custom fields available in a ClickUp Workspace (Team), identified by team_id. Returns Workspace-level custom fields only.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique numerical identifier of the Workspace (Team) for which custom fields are to be retrieved.

tools.name: Get teams
tools.description: Retrieves user groups (Teams) from a ClickUp Workspace, typically requiring `team_id` (Workspace ID), with an option to filter by `group_ids`.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: ID of the ClickUp Workspace (Team ID) from which to retrieve user groups. Must be a positive integer greater than 0. Use the CLICKUP_AUTHORIZATION_GET_WORK_SPACE_LIST action to retrieve available workspace IDs.

inputs.name: group_ids
inputs.about: Comma-separated string of user group IDs to filter results; if omitted, all user groups in the Workspace are returned.

tools.name: Get threaded comments
tools.description: Retrieves threaded replies to a parent comment. Use when you need to fetch conversation threads under a specific comment.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the parent comment to retrieve replies for.

tools.name: Get time entries within a date range
tools.description: Retrieves time entries for a specified Team (Workspace ID) within a date range (defaults to the last 30 days for the authenticated user if dates are omitted); active timers are indicated by negative durations in the response.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: Filter time entries to include only those associated with tasks in a specific List ID.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Filter time entries to include only those associated with a specific task ID. Use with `custom_task_ids` if referring to a custom ID.

inputs.name: team_Id
inputs.about: The Workspace ID (also called Team ID in ClickUp API) for which to retrieve time entries. This goes in the URL path.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Team (Workspace) to use for context when `custom_task_ids` is `true`. This helps resolve custom task IDs. Example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: Filter time entries by user ID(s). For multiple assignees, provide a comma-separated string of user IDs. Example: `1234,9876`. Note: Access to other users' time entries typically requires Workspace Owner/Admin privileges.

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.about: The end date of the date range for filtering time entries, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. If omitted, defaults to the current date.

inputs.name: space_id
inputs.about: Filter time entries to include only those associated with tasks in a specific Space ID.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: Filter time entries to include only those associated with tasks in a specific Folder ID.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.about: The start date of the date range for filtering time entries, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. If omitted, defaults to 30 days prior to the current date.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Set to `true` if the `task_id` parameter refers to a custom task ID. If `true`, the `team_id` query parameter must also be provided for context.

inputs.name: include_task_tags
inputs.about: If true, includes task tags in the response for time entries associated with tasks.

inputs.name: include_location_names
inputs.about: If true, includes the names of the List, Folder, and Space in the response, along with their respective IDs (`list_id`, `folder_id`, `space_id`).

tools.name: Get singular time entry
tools.description: Fetches a specific time entry by its ID for a given team; a negative duration in the response indicates an active timer.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the Team (Workspace).

inputs.name: timer_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the time entry. Can be obtained from the 'Get Time Entries Within a Date Range' action.

inputs.name: include__task
inputs.about: If true and the time entry is associated with a task, includes task details in the response.

inputs.name: include_location_names
inputs.about: If true, includes names of the List, Folder, and Space associated with the time entry, alongside their IDs.

tools.name: Get time entry history
tools.description: Retrieves the modification history for an existing time entry within a specific ClickUp Team (Workspace).

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the Team (Workspace) containing the time entry.

inputs.name: timer_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the time entry for which to retrieve history.

tools.name: Get tracked time
tools.description: Retrieves tracked time for a task using a legacy endpoint; prefer newer Time Tracking API endpoints for managing time entries.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The ID of the task for which to retrieve tracked time. This can be the standard task ID or a custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is set to `true`.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team. This is required and used only when the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Set to `true` if the `task_id` provided is a custom task ID. If `true`, the `team_id` must also be provided.

tools.name: Get user
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific user within a ClickUp Workspace (Team), available only for Workspaces on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: ID of the Team (Workspace) containing the user.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: ID of the user whose details are to be retrieved.

tools.name: Get view
tools.description: Fetches details for a specific ClickUp view, identified by its `view_id`, which must exist.

inputs.name: view_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the ClickUp view to retrieve.

tools.name: Get view tasks
tools.description: Retrieves a page of tasks from a specified ClickUp view, respecting its applied filters, sorting, and grouping. The response indicates whether it is the last page.

inputs.name: page
inputs.about: The page number of the results to retrieve. Used for pagination if the number of tasks exceeds the limit per page. Starts at 0.

inputs.name: view_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for a task view from which to retrieve tasks. Only task views are supported: list, board, calendar, table, timeline, workload, activity, map, or gantt. tools.name: Get webhooks
tools.description: Fetches webhooks for a Team (Workspace), returning only those created by the authenticated user via API, for a `team_id` they can access.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique ID of the Team (Workspace) to retrieve webhooks for. Obtain valid workspace IDs using the 'get_authorized_teams_workspaces' action.

tools.name: Get workspace everything level views
tools.description: Retrieves all task and page views at the 'Everything Level' (a comprehensive overview of all tasks across all Spaces) for a specified ClickUp Workspace.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the Workspace (often referred to as Team ID) for which to retrieve Everything Level views.

inputs.name: archived
inputs.about: Filter for archived views. Set to true to include only archived views, false to exclude archived views, or omit to include all views.

tools.name: Get workspace plan
tools.description: Retrieves the details of the current subscription plan for a specified ClickUp Workspace.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the Workspace (formerly known as Team).

tools.name: Get workspace seats
tools.description: Retrieves seat utilization (used, total, available for members/guests) for a ClickUp Workspace (Team) ID, which must be for an existing Workspace.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the Workspace (Team).

tools.name: Invite guest to workspace
tools.description: Invites a guest by email to a ClickUp Workspace (Team) on an Enterprise Plan, setting initial permissions and optionally a custom role; further access configuration for specific items may require separate actions.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Email address of the guest to invite to the Workspace.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier for the Workspace (Team) to which the guest will be invited.

inputs.name: can_edit_tags
inputs.about: If `true`, the guest has permission to edit tags.

inputs.name: custom_role_id
inputs.about: Optional ID of a custom role to assign to the guest, for granular permission control beyond default guest permissions. Only available on Business Plus Plan (one custom role) or Enterprise Plan (unlimited custom roles).

inputs.name: can_create_views
inputs.about: If `true`, the guest has permission to create views.

inputs.name: can_see_time_spent
inputs.about: If `true`, the guest has permission to see time spent on tasks.

inputs.name: can_see_time_estimated

tools.name: Invite user to workspace
tools.description: Invites a user via email to a ClickUp Workspace (Team), optionally granting admin rights or a custom role; requires an Enterprise Plan for the Workspace.

inputs.name: admin
inputs.about: Grant administrative privileges to the invited user.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Email address of the user to invite.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Workspace (Team) to which the user will be invited.

inputs.name: custom_role_id
inputs.about: Optional custom role ID to assign; if omitted and custom roles are enabled, the default member role is used.

tools.name: Move task to new home list
tools.description: Tool to move a task to a new home List using ClickUp Public API v3. Use when you need to change a task's home list (not just add to additional lists).

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: The destination list ID to move the task to. This will become the task's new home list.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: The task ID to move. Use actual task ID, not custom task ID.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The workspace ID containing the task. Required for v3 endpoint.

inputs.name: status_mappings
inputs.about: Array of status mapping objects to map the task's status from source list to destination list. Each object should contain 'source_status' and 'destination_status' keys. Required when the task's current status doesn't exist in the new list.

inputs.name: move_custom_fields
inputs.about: If true, transfer all custom fields from the current list to the destination list. If false or omitted, custom fields are not moved.

inputs.name: custom_fields_to_move
inputs.about: List of specific custom field IDs to transfer when moving the task. Only applies when move_custom_fields is true. If omitted, all custom fields are moved when move_custom_fields is true.

tools.name: Remove custom field value
tools.description: Removes an existing value from a Custom Field on a specific task; this does not delete the Custom Field definition or its predefined options.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Identifier of the task. If `custom_task_ids` is true, this is the custom task ID; otherwise, it's the standard task ID.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Numeric ID of the team, required only if `custom_task_ids` is true to identify the task by its custom ID.

inputs.name: field_id
inputs.about: UUID of the Custom Field whose value will be removed from the task.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If true, `task_id` is a custom task ID, and `team_id` must also be provided.

tools.name: Remove guest from folder
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific ClickUp Folder, optionally unsharing items explicitly shared with them within it; requires an Enterprise Plan.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the guest to remove from the Folder.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Folder from which to remove the guest.

inputs.name: include_shared
inputs.about: If `true`, items explicitly shared with the guest within this Folder are also unshared.

tools.name: Remove guest from list
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific List, provided the guest currently has access to this List and the Workspace is on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the List from which the guest will be removed.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the guest to be removed from the List.

inputs.name: include_shared
inputs.about: If `false`, may alter how items shared with the guest are handled or reported during removal.

tools.name: Remove guest from task
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific task; only available for Workspaces on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

inputs.about: The ID of the task from which the guest will be removed. This can be the standard task ID or a custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is set to `true`.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the team. This is required only when `custom_task_ids` is set to `true` and you are using a custom task ID. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: The numeric ID of the guest to be removed from the task.

inputs.name: include_shared
inputs.about: Determines whether to include details of items shared with the guest. Set to `false` to exclude these details. Defaults to `true`.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Set to `true` if you are using a custom task ID for the `task_id` parameter. If `true`, `team_id` must also be provided.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: Unique numerical identifier for the guest user whose access to the specified Workspace will be revoked. This ID targets the specific guest for removal.

tools.name: Remove tag from task
tools.description: Removes a tag from a specified task by disassociating it (does not delete the tag from Workspace), succeeding even if the tag is not on the task.

inputs.name: team_id

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: The name of the tag to remove from the task. Tag names are case-sensitive.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: Set to `true` if you are using a custom task ID (instead of the default task ID) to identify the task. If `true`, the `team_id` must also be provided.

tools.name: Remove tags from time entries
tools.description: Removes tags from specified time entries in a team, without deleting the tags from the workspace.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the Team (Workspace) that owns the time entries.

inputs.name: time_entry_ids
inputs.about: List of time entry IDs from which to remove tags.

tools.name: Remove task from list
tools.description: Removes a task from an extra list (not its home list); the 'Tasks in Multiple Lists' ClickApp must be enabled.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the task to be removed from the specified list.

tools.name: Remove user from workspace
tools.description: Deactivates a user from a specified ClickUp Workspace, revoking their access (user can be reactivated later); requires the Workspace to be on an Enterprise Plan.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier of the Workspace (Team) from which the user will be deactivated.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: The unique numeric identifier of the user to be deactivated from the Workspace.

tools.name: Search Docs

inputs.name: cursor

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: ID of the ClickUp Workspace to list Docs from.

inputs.name: value_options
inputs.about: Optional settings for certain field types. For Date fields: {'time': true} to display time in ClickUp UI. For Currency fields: {'currency_type': 'USD'} to specify currency.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: The full content of the message to be updated. Maximum 40,000 characters. If not provided, message content will not be changed.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: The possible assignee of the message. User ID as string.

inputs.name: resolved
inputs.about: The resolved status of the message. Set to true to mark as resolved, false to mark as unresolved.

inputs.name: post_data
inputs.about: Post data subtype information.

inputs.name: message_id

inputs.name: workspace_id

inputs.name: content_format

inputs.name: group_assignee
