tools.name: Edit checklist
tools.description: Updates an existing checklist's name or position, identified by its `checklist_id`.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the checklist.

inputs.name: position
inputs.about: New 0-indexed display order for the checklist on a task (e.g., 0 for top).

inputs.name: checklist_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (UUID) of the checklist to be edited.

tools.name: Edit checklist item
tools.description: Updates an existing checklist item, allowing modification of its name, assignee, resolution status, or parent item for nesting.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the checklist item.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: The `checklist_item_id` of an existing item within the same checklist to nest this item under.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: The integer user ID to assign to this checklist item. To unassign, consult ClickUp API documentation for the appropriate value (e.g., 0 or null).

inputs.name: resolved
inputs.about: Set to `true` to mark the item as resolved, or `false` to mark it as unresolved.

inputs.name: checklist_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (UUID) of the checklist containing the item to be edited.

inputs.name: checklist_item_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (UUID) of the checklist item to be edited.

tools.name: Update comment
tools.description: Updates an existing task comment by ID, supplying its text, assignee, and resolution status.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: User ID of the assignee for the comment.

inputs.name: resolved
inputs.about: Set to `true` to mark the comment as resolved, or `false` to mark it as unresolved.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the comment to be updated.

inputs.name: comment_text
inputs.about: The new text content for the comment.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Updates the name of an existing folder in ClickUp.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the folder.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the folder to update.

tools.name: Update goal
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp goal by ID. Requires its name, description, due date, color, and lists of owners to add and remove.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the goal.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: New color (hex code).

inputs.name: goal_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier (UUID) of the goal to update.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: New due date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds).

inputs.name: add_owners
inputs.about: User IDs to add as owners.

inputs.name: rem_owners
inputs.about: User IDs to remove as owners.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: New description for the goal.

tools.name: Edit guest on workspace
tools.description: Modifies the details and permissions of an existing guest user within a specific Workspace.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Workspace (Team) where the guest belongs. Example: 123456.

inputs.name: guest_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the guest user to be edited. Example: 98765.

inputs.name: username
inputs.about: The new username to assign to the guest. Optional - only include if you want to change the guest's username.

inputs.name: can_edit_tags
inputs.about: Boolean flag to allow or disallow the guest to edit tags. Optional - only include if you want to change this permission.

inputs.name: custom_role_id
inputs.about: Identifier of a custom role for the guest. Ensure this ID is valid within the workspace. Optional - only include if you want to assign/change the custom role. (Note: Business Plus Plan supports one custom role; Enterprise Plan supports unlimited).

inputs.name: can_create_views
inputs.about: Boolean flag to allow or disallow the guest to create views. Optional - only include if you want to change this permission.

inputs.name: can_see_time_spent
inputs.about: Boolean flag to allow or disallow the guest to see time spent on tasks. Optional - only include if you want to change this permission.

inputs.name: can_see_time_estimated
inputs.about: Boolean flag to allow or disallow the guest to see time estimated for tasks. Optional - only include if you want to change this permission.

tools.name: Edit key result
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp key result's progress and note. Both the current progress value and note are required.

inputs.name: note
inputs.about: A note or comment to add or update for the key result.

inputs.name: key_result_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier (UUID) of the key result to be edited.

inputs.name: steps_current
inputs.about: The current progress of steps for the key result.

tools.name: Update list
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing ClickUp list, such as its name, content, due date, priority, assignee, or color status, identified by its `list_id`.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New name for the list.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Color for the list (e.g., 'red' or '#FF0000'), visually representing its status (not task status).

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: New description or informational content for the list.

inputs.name: list_id
inputs.about: ID of the list to be updated.

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.about: User ID to be set as the assignee for the list, replacing any existing assignee.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: New due date for the list, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds (e.g., `1672531199000` for Dec 31, 2022, 11:59:59 PM UTC).

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Priority level: `1` (Urgent), `2` (High), `3` (Normal), `4` (Low), or `0` to unset.

inputs.name: unset_status
inputs.about: Set to `true` to remove the list's color, overriding `status`; if `false`, `status` updates or maintains current color.

inputs.name: due_date_time
inputs.about: Indicates if `due_date` includes a specific time; if `false`, it's an all-day event.

tools.name: Update space
tools.description: Updates a ClickUp Space's name, color, privacy, multiple-assignee setting, and optionally its feature settings (ClickApps). The name, color, privacy, and multiple-assignee setting are required.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the Space.

inputs.name: color
inputs.about: The new color for the Space, in hexadecimal format.

inputs.name: private
inputs.about: Whether the Space should be private.

inputs.name: space_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Space to update.

inputs.name: admin_can_manage
inputs.about: Whether admins can manage this private Space. This is an Enterprise Plan feature. Must be omitted for non-Enterprise workspaces.

inputs.name: multiple_assignees
inputs.about: Whether tasks in this Space can have multiple assignees.

inputs.name: features__tags__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the Tags ClickApp. When any feature parameter is provided, all feature keys must be included (due_dates, time_estimates, time_tracking, remap_dependencies, custom_fields, dependency_warning, tags, checklists, portfolios).

inputs.name: features__due_dates__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the Due Dates ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__checklists__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the Checklists ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__portfolios__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the Portfolios ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__due_dates__start_date
inputs.about: Enable or disable Start Dates for the Due Dates ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__custom_fields__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the Custom Fields ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__time_tracking__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the Time Tracking ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__time_estimates__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the Time Estimates ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__due_dates__remap_due_dates
inputs.about: Enable or disable remapping of due dates for the Due Dates ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__dependency_warning__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable Dependency Warning for the Task Dependencies ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__remap_dependencies__enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable Remap Dependencies for the Task Dependencies ClickApp.

inputs.name: features__due_dates__remap_closed_due_date
inputs.about: Enable or disable remapping of closed due dates for the Due Dates ClickApp.

tools.name: Edit space tag
tools.description: Updates an existing tag's name and colors in a ClickUp Space; requires current tag name for identification, and new values for tag name, foreground color, and background color, all of which are mandatory for the update.

inputs.name: space_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the Space containing the tag.

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.about: Current name of the tag to edit. This tag must exist within the specified Space.

inputs.name: tag__name
inputs.about: New name to assign to the tag.

inputs.name: tag__bg__color
inputs.about: New background color for the tag, specified as a hexadecimal string (e.g., '#000000').

inputs.name: tag__fg__color
inputs.about: New foreground color for the tag, specified as a hexadecimal string (e.g., '#FFFFFF').

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing task; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true, use a single space (" ") for `description` to clear it, and provide at least one modifiable field.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: New task name.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.about: ID of new parent task to make this a subtask; cannot convert subtask to regular task this way.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: New task status (case-sensitive, must be valid in Workspace).

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Unique task identifier; use custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Team ID, required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: archived
inputs.about: True to archive, false to unarchive.

inputs.name: due_date
inputs.about: New due date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds).

inputs.name: priority
inputs.about: Priority: 1 (Urgent), 2 (High), 3 (Normal), 4 (Low). Omit or `None` to remove.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.about: New start date (Unix timestamp in milliseconds).

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: New task description; use a single space (" ") to clear.

inputs.name: due_date_time
inputs.about: True if `due_date` includes time, false if all-day.

inputs.name: time_estimate
inputs.about: New time estimate in milliseconds.

inputs.name: assignees__add
inputs.about: List of user IDs to add as assignees.

inputs.name: assignees__rem
inputs.about: List of user IDs to remove as assignees.

inputs.name: custom_item_id
inputs.about: Custom task type ID. Use `1` for Milestone, its ID for custom type. Omit/`None` to make regular task (API's 'null' equivalent).

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If true, `task_id` is a custom ID and `team_id` is required.

inputs.name: start_date_time
inputs.about: True if `start_date` includes time, false if all-day.

tools.name: Update team
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp User Group (Team) using its `group_id`; note that adding a view-only guest as a paid member may incur charges.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the User Group (Team).

inputs.name: handle
inputs.about: The new handle for the User Group (Team), used for @mentions (e.g., '@developers').

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The ID of the User Group (Team) to update.

inputs.name: members__add
inputs.about: A list of user IDs to add to the User Group (Team).

inputs.name: members__rem
inputs.about: A list of user IDs to remove from the User Group (Team).

tools.name: Update a time entry
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp time entry. Requires team_id (workspace ID) and timer_id (time entry ID). Optional fields: description, tags, tag_action, start/end times, duration, tid (task ID), billable status. Note: start and end times should be provided together. This is an Advanced Time Tracking feature that may require a Business Plan or higher.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: New end time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds). If provided, `start` must also be provided.

inputs.name: tid
inputs.about: The ID of the task for this time entry; if `custom_task_ids` is `true`, this should be the custom task ID.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.about: List of tag objects (e.g., `{'name': 'your-tag'}`) for the time entry. Time tracking labels are for Business Plan and above users.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: New start time (Unix timestamp in milliseconds). If provided, `end` must also be provided.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Team (Workspace) for the time entry. Path parameter.

inputs.name: billable
inputs.about: Indicates whether the time entry is billable.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.about: New duration of the time entry in milliseconds; can be an alternative to `start` and `end` times.

inputs.name: timer_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the time entry to update. Path parameter.

inputs.name: tag_action
inputs.about: Specifies how to handle `tags` (e.g., 'add', 'remove').

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: A new description for the time entry.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If `true`, `tid` is interpreted as a custom task ID. When true, the team_id path parameter value will also be used as a query parameter.

tools.name: Change tag names from time entries
tools.description: Updates an existing time entry tag in a workspace, identified by its current name. Requires the new name, background color, and foreground color.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The current name of the time entry tag to be modified.

inputs.name: tag_bg
inputs.about: The new background color for the tag, specified as a hexadecimal color code.

inputs.name: tag_fg
inputs.about: The new foreground (text) color for the tag, specified as a hexadecimal color code.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Team (Workspace) where the time entry tag exists.

inputs.name: new_name
inputs.about: The new name to be assigned to the time entry tag.

tools.name: Edit time tracked
tools.description: Edits a legacy time-tracked interval for a task (identified by `task_id` and `interval_id`) to update its start/end times and duration; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: end
inputs.about: New end date and time for the interval as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: time
inputs.about: New total duration of the time interval in milliseconds; typically the difference between `end` and `start`.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: New start date and time for the interval as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

inputs.name: task_id
inputs.about: Unique task identifier; refers to custom task ID if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Team ID, required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

inputs.name: interval_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the time interval record to edit.

inputs.name: custom_task_ids
inputs.about: If true, `task_id` is treated as a custom task ID, and `team_id` must be provided.

tools.name: Edit user on workspace
tools.description: Updates a user's username, admin status, or custom role in a Workspace; requires the Workspace to be on an Enterprise Plan.

inputs.name: admin
inputs.about: Set `true` to make user an admin, `false` to revoke admin privileges. Optional - only include if you want to change admin status.

inputs.name: team_id
inputs.about: Workspace (formerly Team) ID where the user resides.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: ID of the user whose details are to be edited.

inputs.name: username
inputs.about: New username to assign. Optional - only include if you want to change the username.

inputs.name: custom_role_id
inputs.about: ID of the custom role to assign, defining their permissions. Optional - only include if you want to change the custom role.

tools.name: Update view
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp view's settings such as name, type, grouping, or filters; ensure `parent_id` and `parent_type` define a valid hierarchy, and that specified field names (e.g. for sorting, columns) are valid within the ClickUp workspace.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the view.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: The type of the view.

inputs.name: view_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the view to be updated.

inputs.name: parent__id
inputs.about: The ID of the Workspace, Space, Folder, or List where the view is located.

inputs.name: divide__dir
inputs.about: The direction for dividing the view. Currently, this field may not be actively used or may be deprecated.

inputs.name: filters__op
inputs.about: The operator for combining filters. Available values are `AND` and `OR`.

inputs.name: parent__type
inputs.about: The level of the Hierarchy where the view is created. Options include: Workspace (Everything Level): `7`, Space: `4`, Folder: `5`, List: `6`.

inputs.name: divide__field
inputs.about: The field to divide the view by (e.g., to create swimlanes in a board view). Currently, this field may not be actively used or may be deprecated.

inputs.name: grouping__dir
inputs.about: The sort order for grouping. Use `1` for ascending (e.g., urgent priority at the top) or `-1` for descending (e.g., no priority at the top).

inputs.name: columns__fields
inputs.about: Fields to display as columns in the view. Custom Fields require the `_cf` prefix and their ID (e.g., `_cf_custom_field_id`).

inputs.name: filters__fields
inputs.about: Fields to apply filters on; refer to ClickUp API documentation for available fields.

inputs.name: filters__search
inputs.about: A search string to filter tasks by name or content.

inputs.name: grouping__field
inputs.about: The field to group tasks by. Options include: `none`, `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `tag`, or `dueDate`.

inputs.name: sorting__fields
inputs.about: Fields to sort tasks by; refer to ClickUp API documentation for available filter fields.

inputs.name: grouping__ignore
inputs.about: If true, tasks with no value for the `grouping_field` will not be grouped.

inputs.name: divide__collapsed
inputs.about: Indicates if divided sections should be collapsed. Currently, this field may not be actively used or may be deprecated.

inputs.name: grouping__collapsed
inputs.about: A list of group identifiers (e.g., status names or assignee IDs) that should be collapsed by default in the view.

inputs.name: filters__show__closed
inputs.about: If true, closed tasks will be included in the view.

inputs.name: settings__me__comments
inputs.about: If true, in 'Me Mode', only comments where the current user is mentioned or involved will be shown.

inputs.name: settings__me__subtasks
inputs.about: If true, in 'Me Mode', only subtasks assigned to the current user will be shown.

inputs.name: settings__show__images
inputs.about: If true, images attached to tasks will be displayed in the view (e.g. cover images in card view).

inputs.name: settings__me__checklists
inputs.about: If true, in 'Me Mode', only checklists assigned to the current user will be shown.

inputs.name: settings__show__subtasks
inputs.about: Controls how subtasks are displayed. Acceptable values are `1` (show subtasks as separate tasks), `2` (show subtasks expanded under parent task), or `3` (show subtasks collapsed under parent task).

inputs.name: team__sidebar__assignees
inputs.about: A list of assignee user IDs to feature in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: settings__show__assignees
inputs.about: If true, assignees will be displayed on tasks.

inputs.name: settings__show__task__locations
inputs.about: If true, task locations (List, Folder, Space) will be displayed.

inputs.name: settings__show__closed__subtasks
inputs.about: If true, closed subtasks will be included in the view.

inputs.name: team__sidebar__unassigned__tasks
inputs.about: If true, unassigned tasks will be shown in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: team__sidebar__assigned__comments
inputs.about: If true, assigned comments will be shown in the team sidebar.

inputs.name: settings__collapse__empty__columns
inputs.about: If true, columns with no tasks will be collapsed (e.g., in Board view). This might accept boolean as a string like 'true' or 'false'.

inputs.name: settings__show__subtask__parent__names
inputs.about: If true, parent task names will be displayed for subtasks.

tools.name: Update webhook
tools.description: Updates the endpoint URL, monitored events, and status of an existing webhook, identified by its `webhook_id`.

inputs.name: events
inputs.about: List of event types to monitor. Use ["*"] to subscribe to all events. Common events include: taskCreated, taskUpdated, taskDeleted, taskStatusUpdated, taskAssigneeUpdated, taskDueDateUpdated, taskTagUpdated, taskMoved, taskCommentPosted, taskCommentUpdated, listCreated, listUpdated, listDeleted, fol

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: The desired status of the webhook after the update.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.about: The new URL where the webhook payloads will be sent.

inputs.name: webhook_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the webhook to be updated. Example: 'e506-4a29-9d42-26e504e3435e'.

tools.name: Update workspace ACL
tools.description: Updates privacy and access control list (ACL) permissions for a workspace object or location. Use this to make objects private/public or manage user/team permissions for spaces, folders, lists, tasks, and other ClickUp objects.

inputs.name: entries
inputs.about: The user or user group (Team) entries to give, remove, or edit permissions. Each entry must include 'kind' (user or user_group) and 'id'. Optionally include 'permission_level' to set specific permissions.

inputs.name: private
inputs.about: Set the privacy of the object or location. True for private, false for public.

inputs.name: object_id
inputs.about: The ID of the specific object to update ACL permissions for.

inputs.name: object_type
inputs.about: The type of object to update ACL permissions for.

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.about: The ID of the Workspace. Numeric string.
